# ArtRage

> ArtRage is a professional digital painting software suite with realistic natural media brushes for desktop and mobile platforms, offering solutions for artists of all skill levels.

ArtRage, developed by Ambient Design, provides digital painting tools across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android. The product line includes ArtRage 6 (professional desktop), ArtRage Vitae (mobile with collaboration), and ArtRage Lite (beginner-friendly), along with comprehensive support and educational resources.

## Key Topics

- ArtRage 6
- ArtRage Vitae
- ArtRage Lite
- Digital painting software
- Realistic brushes
- Natural media simulation
- Cross-platform (Windows, macOS, iOS, Android)
